Get to Know Us

Welcome to the City of Baltimore! Experience the reward of a fulfilling career and enjoy the added element of excitement in a vibrant, diverse atmosphere. The City of Baltimore offers limitless opportunities to help drive social impact, both on the job and in the community, while serving its citizens. Join us in making Baltimore a great place to live and work. In the City of Baltimore, we hire great people and provide them with the skills and opportunities to grow toward their career aspirations. If you are looking for a career change or are interested in learning more, explore our opportunities and benefits programs. We are excited to have you as a part of the City of Baltimore Team! The city offers medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, optional life, AD&D, and FSA plans. This office also supplies wellness programs, support groups, and workshops. You can learn about our benefits here: https://humanresources.baltimorecity.gov/hr-divisions/benefits

About the Mayor’s Office of Performance and Innovation (OPI)

OPI is Baltimore’s in-house strategy, performance, data, and innovation team. We work across City agencies to strengthen service delivery, build modern data and digital capabilities, and promote transparency. OPI uses data, design, and performance management to improve services in ways that residents and staff can see and feel.

Job Summary

The Senior Full Stack Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and maintains modern web applications and digital products for Baltimore City. The role develops accessible front-end experiences, secure back-end services, application programming interfaces, integrations, and reusable components that support internal operations, executive decisions, resident services, and public transparency. Development is informed by a strong understanding of City processes and grounded in data. The Full Stack Engineer reports to the Innovation Program Manager and works closely with civic designers, applied data scientists, data engineers, agency subject-matter experts, and Baltimore City Information and Technology (BCIT). The position is responsible for production-quality software and for ensuring that products are maintainable, documented, monitored, and ready for long-term ownership.

Essential Functions

Software Design and Development



- Design and build accessible, responsive web applications using React and Python frameworks such as Django or Flask.
- Develop secure application programming interfaces, integrations, database services, and reusable front-end and back-end components.
- Translate data and analytical outputs into reliable interactive products that support residents, staff, and City leaders.
- Make sound technical choices about architecture, performance, maintainability, and reuse within approved City standards.

Data Science and Analytics



- Parse complex datasets to understand patterns, trends, outliers, and opportunities to inform application development.
- Ability to design visualizations and front-end components based on relevant data patterns.
- Ensure applications reflect source-of-truth data sources and validated with robust QA/QC methods.
- Implement innovative data science methods such as machine learning, natural language processing, and remote sensing.

Quality, Security, and Operations



- Write maintainable code with automated tests, peer review, clear documentation, and version control.
- Apply accessibility, privacy, cybersecurity, records, and responsible-use requirements throughout development.
- Implement deployment, logging, monitoring, alerting, support, and recovery practices appropriate to each product.
- Investigate defects and incidents, communicate impact, and deliver durable fixes.

Product Collaboration and Sustainment



- Work with designers, applied data scientists, program managers, agency staff, and end users to define requirements and acceptance criteria.
- Participate in discovery, prototyping, demonstrations, usability testing, and iterative improvement.
- Prepare technical documentation, runbooks, release notes, and handoff materials and support training and long-term ownership.
- Contribute reusable components, patterns, and lessons learned to OPI’s product practice.

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Have a bachelor’s Degree in Computer or Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field from an accredited college or university

AND

Experience: Have five or more years of progressively responsible experience developing and maintaining full stack web applications, or an equivalent combination of professional, academic, and portfolio experience.

OR

Equivalency Notes: Have an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Knowledge of automated testing, version control, code review, deployment, monitoring, performance, security, and incident response

Additional Information

Background Check

Eligible candidates under final consideration for appointment to positions identified as positions of trust will be required to complete authorization for a Criminal Background Check and/or Fingerprint screening, and must be successfully completed.

Probation

All persons, including current City employees, selected for this position must complete a 6-month mandatory probation.

Financial Disclosure

This position is required to complete a Financial Disclosure pursuant to Sections 7-7, 7-8, and 7-9 of the City Ethics Law. The initial financial disclosure must be submitted within 30 days of hire.

Baltimore City Government is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. The City of Baltimore prohibits discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, ancestry, creed, national origin, disability status, genetics, marital status, military service, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Applicants requiring accommodation during the hiring process should contact the Department of Human Resources directly. Requests for accommodation should not be attached to the application.

Description

About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will build web applications end to end, from the interface a user sees to the data layer behind it. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your First Project Will Likely Have You Building Full-stack Features In PHP And Laravel, With Python Alongside. Depending On The Assignment, You May

  • Build features end to end: Laravel on the back end, React or Vue on the front, and REST application programming interfaces (APIs) into third-party systems. These applications carry heavy concurrent traffic, and you write unit and integration tests for what you ship.
  • Deploy and run it on Amazon Web Services (AWS). You write the Python automation behind it and the caching that keeps it fast as traffic grows.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional full-stack development experience with PHP/Laravel and Python
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • Expert-level PHP and Laravel: MVC architecture and Eloquent ORM
  • HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+), with at least one front-end framework (React or Vue.js)
  • Python for scripting, automation, and web development (Django or Flask)
  • Relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and query optimization for web applications
  • AWS deployment experience: EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, and Route 53
  • Git-based version control and modern tooling (Composer, npm/yarn)
  • HTTP, web security principles, API design, and responsive design
  • Clear writing and speaking for both technical and non-technical readers: documenting decisions, writing for client stakeholders, presenting your own work

Preferred

  • Large language model (LLM) API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt engineering
  • Blockchain and smart-contract integration (Web3)
  • A portfolio of shipped full-stack projects
  • Federal information technology experience
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tooling

Who you are

You build the whole feature, not just your half, and you care whether it holds up under real traffic. When something breaks, you can trace it across the interface, the data, and the deployment, and fix it wherever it actually lives. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • Production PHP and Laravel, with the architectural judgment to keep an application responsive as concurrent users grow.
  • Modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with React or Vue, to build responsive interfaces.
  • Relational data models and query optimization for web applications, in MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Python for the data processing and automation that support the application.
  • Practical delivery on AWS using EC2, RDS, S3, and CloudFront, including the caching and loading strategies that keep a growing application fast.

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a live Laravel coding challenge without AI.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $100,000 to $150,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

descriptionHtml:
AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.

Who We Are Looking For

Are you passionate about expanding housing opportunities? Do you want to play your part in addressing the affordable housing crisis in the US? We are hiring a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to join an exceptional team and become a technical domain expert in our Affordable Housing space. Our team aims to make applying for, living in, and managing affordable housing units feel effortless and simple. Affordable Housing is an enormously complex domain - requiring complex data gathering and recurring submission of that data for certification and compliance—all within a diverse and ever-shifting regulatory environment. Things get very complicated very fast and property managers can struggle to keep up. With this team’s focus, innovation, and attention to detail, we see a future where it doesn’t have to be this way.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who has a passion for building leading-edge software and is driven to help build a successful SaaS product used by thousands of happy businesses. We foster an environment that empowers small teams to set the technical direction of our solutions collaboratively.

Responsibilities

  • Build a deep understanding of our existing Affordable Housing segment, enabling you and your team to truly own the domain.
  • Develop scalable, robust, and simple web-based solutions to solve complex business problems - this will involve some combination of leveraging our existing technology, refactoring, integrating with partners, or starting from scratch when it makes sense.
  • Help mentor and guide other software engineers.
  • Implement new features and optimize existing ones to drive maximum performance.
  • Work closely with and incorporate feedback from other engineering team members, QA, product owners, and designers. Enthusiastically participate in a high-performing, empowered team with high levels of mutual trust and respect. Along with the team, you will take ownership of your problem space, reflecting on and growing from our failures and celebrating our successes.
  • Work in a truly agile fashion to turn a massive, unruly problem into thinly sliced deliverables and execute quickly against them while limiting work in progress.
  • Research, share, and recommend new technologies and trends.
  • Hold a high bar of engineering excellence and always look for ways to raise it. Adopt our engineering best practices, provide and receive in-depth code reviews, and participate in healthy debate as a team. Evangelize your own expertise and experience among your teammates and the rest of the organization.
  • Prioritize quality. Thoughtful test coverage is a given and any escalations from external stakeholders like our onboarding or customer care teams are handled and resolved swiftly. Use test-driven development, code reviews, and continuous integration to deliver high-quality software and rapidly fix bugs as they come up.

You know you are the right fit if you…

  • Have extensive experience developing web applications, preferably in an agile SaaS environment.
  • Have proven experience working across all levels of the development stack.
  • Have strong familiarity with the technologies we use like Ruby on Rails, React, MySQL, AWS, SOA
  • Have strong familiarity with Agile software development processes: Scrum or Kanban
  • Have strong familiarity with Test-Driven-Development
  • Have creativity and proactivity - an ability to solve complex problems without a roadmap
  • Love to learn about and use new tech, but understand the value of continuing to leverage existing technology when it gets the job done.
  • Care about the long-term maintainability of the codebase and advocate for refactoring and code cleanliness.
  • Can identify and resolve code-smells through sensible refactoring.

Additional Skills And Knowledge

  • 5+ years of experience working in software engineering teams
  • Comfortable working with remote team members
  • Ability to think pragmatically and effectively balance business outcomes with technical goals
  • Ability to establish strong working relationships with peers across other platform development teams.

Nice To Have

  • Experience working across all levels of the development stack
  • Experience with some areas of our tech like Ruby on Rails, React, MySQL, AWS, SOA
  • Familiarity with Agile software development processes: Scrum or Kanban
  • Familiarity with Test-Driven-Development
  • Knowledge of TRACS, iMAX system , Knowledge of HUD 202D Guidelines

Location

Find out more about our locations by visiting our site.

All late-stage candidates complete an in-person meeting with an AppFolian as part of our hiring process.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary that we reasonably expect to pay for this role is $138,400 - $190,300

The actual base salary for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, etc.

Please note that base pay is one important aspect of a compelling Total Rewards package. The base pay range indicated here does not include any additional benefits or bonuses/commissions that you may be eligible for based on your role and/or employment type. Regular full-time employees are eligible for benefits - see here.

About AppFolio

AppFolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. Our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. For more information about AppFolio, visit appfolio.com.

Why AppFolio

Grow | We enable a culture of high performance, where delivering results is recognized by opportunities for growth and compelling total rewards. Our challenging and meaningful work drive the growth of our business, and ourselves.

Learn | We partner with you to realize your potential by investing in you from the start. We're cultivating a team of big thinkers through coaching and mentorship with our best-in-class leaders, and giving you the time and tools to develop your skills.

Impact | We are creating a world where living in, investing in, managing, and supporting communities feels magical and effortless, freeing people to thrive. We do this by innovating with purpose while cultivating a culture of impact. We learn as much from each other as we do our customers and our communities.

Connect | We excel at hybrid work by fostering an environment that feels flexible, personal and connected, no matter where we are. We create space to fuel innovation and collaboration, and we come together to celebrate, connect, and succeed.

Paddle as One.

Learn more at appfolio.com/company/careers

Statement of Equal Opportunity

At AppFolio, we value diversity in backgrounds and perspectives and depend on it to drive our innovative culture. That’s why we’re a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we believe that our products, our teams, and our business are stronger because of it. This means that no matter what race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, or medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by law, you’re always welcome at AppFolio.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible candidate experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process for a disability, pregnancy-related condition, or religious practice, please contact us at peopleoperations@appfolio.com or (805) 284-0834. You do not need to use any particular wording.

descriptionHtml:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

About The Role

We build an advanced data platform that helps demanding enterprise and public-sector customers turn large, complex datasets into high-quality, structured data for AI. We're a small, senior team that values ownership, correctness, and strong engineering. We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help build and operate the product end to end, and to work closely with the customers who use it. You'll spend most of your time building, with regular chances to join customer conversations, help deploy the platform in their environments, and see how it's used in the field. It's a great fit for an engineer who enjoys working with customers and wants to grow into a more customer-facing role.

What You'll Do

  • Build features end to end across our Rust backend and TypeScript/React frontend, from the data model and APIs to a polished, interactive web application.
  • Design data models, APIs, and ingestion pipelines that are fast and reliable at scale.
  • Help deploy, configure, and support the platform in cloud and customer environments, including AWS GovCloud, on-premises Kubernetes, and air-gapped or classified networks.
  • Build data connectors and integrations that bring customer data into the platform and fit it to their workflows.
  • Join customer conversations, demos, and occasional on-site visits to understand how the product is used, and turn that feedback into product improvements.
  • Contribute to architecture, code quality, performance, and security as the product grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building and shipping production software.
  • Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility (U.S. citizenship required).
  • Strong backend skills in a modern systems or application language (we work primarily in Rust; we're happy to help a strong engineer ramp up).
  • Solid SQL and PostgreSQL fundamentals — indexing, transactions, and query performance.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript and React and an eye for clean, responsive UIs.
  • Experience deploying and running services with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong communication skills — able to explain technical work clearly to customers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel to customer sites.

Nice To Have

  • Customer-facing, consulting, or solutions-engineering experience.
  • Experience deploying software in classified, air-gapped, or other regulated environments.
  • AWS/EKS (including GovCloud), infrastructure-as-code, and STIG or RMF experience.
  • Experience with data-intensive applications, data pipelines, or Python for data work.
  • Familiarity with AI training data, annotation, or data-labeling workflows.

Core Technologies

  • Rust
  • TypeScript / React
  • PostgreSQL
  • Python
  • cloud object storage
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • AWS (including GovCloud). (Additional components shared during the interview process.)

Eligibility

  • U.S. citizenship and an active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility are required. This role is open to candidates anywhere in the U.S. (remote) or hybrid in the Washington, DC area, with occasional travel to customer sites.

Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to Innodata at verifyjoboffer@innodata.com and consider reporting it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.

descriptionHtml:
Job Requirements

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class products, across merchandising and publishing. As the world's largest licensor, we work with global licensees who sell Disney branded products, as well as support our own parks and resorts merchandising business for product creation. We also support a large publishing arm within Disney and a vast licensing landscape for printed books, e-books, and educational products.

The Sr. Software Engineer will report to the Manager of Software Engineering.

About The Role & Team

In this role, you’ll partner with product and engineering teams and merchandising and publishing stakeholders around the globe. You’ll build and support a mix of SaaS and internal systems that enable product and title lifecycle management, royalty payments, and digital asset management.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build. Develop scalable software systems, applications, and components across local, networked, cloud-based, and Internet-related environments.
  • Deliver end-to-end solutions. Analyze requirements and design, develop, test, debug, and implement software enhancements, fixes, and new applications.
  • Lead projects. Take ownership of small projects, guiding development from analysis and design through implementation and delivery.
  • Build high-quality software. Write reliable code at the component level for sophisticated software programs, end-user applications, infrastructure, and technology platforms.
  • Test and troubleshoot. Perform application testing, debugging, and cross-system troubleshooting to maintain software quality and performance.
  • Partner with users. Work directly with users and stakeholders to understand system requirements and identify necessary enhancements or modifications.
  • Apply technical expertise. Use current programming languages and technologies to solve complex problems and deliver effective solutions.
  • Stay current. Keep up with emerging technologies and apply new approaches where they can improve products, platforms, and engineering practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of related software engineering experience.
  • Experience working effectively in an Agile environment.
  • Core Proficiencies | Full Stack Engineer
  • Backend development using Java and REST/GraphQL APIs.
  • JavaScript/TypeScript with a modern frontend framework such as React/Vue/Angular.
  • SQL, database design, and ORM experience.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, and Docker.
  • Cloud platform experience with AWS/GCP/Azure.
  • Experience with unit and integration testing and cross-stack debugging.
  • Understanding of system design principles and technical tradeoffs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes or other container orchestration.
  • Exposure to microservices architecture and event-driven systems using Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS.
  • Experience designing GraphQL APIs.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, CloudFormation.
  • Experience with observability tooling such as Datadog, New Relic, ELK stack.
  • Experience with performance optimization, including frontend rendering, query tuning, and caching strategies.
  • Experience contributing to design and architecture discussions or RFCs.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers or interns.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Required Education

Bachelor's or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience.

descriptionHtml:
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Deloitte's Cyber team helps our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. We simplify complexity, and enable businesses to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage their security posture.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

The Team:

Deloitte's Cyber Engineering is a new team that is spearheading the buildout of Cybersecurity technology that will underpin the next generation of our Cybersecurity services. Join us as we work with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity to build future capabilities today.

Position Summary

Join Deloitte's Cyber Engineering team to help build technology that supports the next generation of cybersecurity services. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will design, develop, and enhance applications across frontend and backend environments, working with modern engineering practices and cloud-based technologies. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions that support client and business needs.

Work you'll do

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Cyber Engineering team, you will be responsible for...

  • Collaborating with business stakeholders, engineers, and team leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Designing, developing, testing, and enhancing full stack applications across frontend and backend technologies
  • Building and integrating application programming interfaces, microservices, and cloud-based services to support product functionality
  • Supporting product quality through code reviews, testing, debugging, and continuous integration and continuous deployment practices
  • Contributing to technical analysis, solution design, and delivery activities that support client outcomes and product development

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or a similar technical field
  • 2-3+ years experience in the following areas:
    • 2-3+ years of experience in full stack development across frontend and backend technologies, including experience with Angular, React, or Next.js and JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3
    • 2-3+ years of experience in backend development using Node.js, Python with Django or Flask, or Java with Spring Boot
    • 2-3+ years of experience building and consuming Representational State Transfer application programming interfaces and working with microservices or serverless architectures in production environments
    • 2-3+ years of experience working with relational databases and at least 1 NoSQL database, and using Git, Azure DevOps or similar tools, Docker, Agile or Scrum methods, automated testing, and continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines
    • 1-3+ years of experience developing, integrating, or deploying artificial intelligence, Generative AI, or agentic AI solutions within enterprise applications on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
Preferred:

  • Experience with object-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean coding practices
  • Experience building secure, reusable, responsive, and maintainable applications
  • Experience with secure development practices, DevOps, DevSecOps, web security, GitOps, or Kubernetes customization
  • Experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Neo4j, Memgraph, Maven, or Gradle
  • Experience with Bootstrap, jQuery, or JavaServer Pages in legacy or mixed-technology environments
  • Cloud certification in Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $100,400 to $197,900.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Information for applicants with a need for accommodation: https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/careers/articles/join-deloitte-assistance-for-disabled-applicants.html

descriptionHtml:
Aerospace runs on software the rest of the industry stopped buying a decade ago. The system that holds every part design takes six clicks to find a part number. The system that runs the factory floor takes two years to roll out. Most aerospace OEMs have accepted this. We have not.

At Boom we are building Boomie — the integrated software platform that connects design, supply chain, manufacturing, and test into one coherent system. It is the digital backbone of how our aircraft and engines get built. We are building it ourselves because the vendors who sell aerospace software stopped innovating before most of our engineers graduated college.

We are hiring Senior Full Stack Software Engineers to own domains of Boomie end-to-end. You will sit with the aerospace engineer burning twenty minutes a day copying part numbers between systems, decide what to build, and have it in their hands by the end of the week. You will design APIs that humans and AI agents consume on equal footing, because we have no pre-AI architecture to retrofit.

What You'll Do

companyDescription: SentiLink, the leading provider of innovative identity and risk solutions, empowers institutions and individuals to transact confidently with one another by preventing synthetic fraud, identity theft, and emerging forms of first party fraud at the point of account application. Its solutions enable these secure transactions by leveraging a deep understanding of identity and risk, and are informed by machine learning models and insights from a team of top risk analysts. SentiLink proudly serves a broad array of financial institutions, from the largest U.S. banks to leading credit unions and fintech unicorns to help stop fraud at account opening and beyond. Headquartered in San Francisco, the company was founded in 2017 by Naftali Harris and Max Blumenfeld and it has raised $85M to date from investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Craft Ventures, and NYCA Partners, among others.
companySlogan: Your fraud and risk partner
descriptionHtml:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack you will be responsible for the development and maintenance of our web application and platform that is used for Fraud analysis. You will be working closely with Product & Design, Solutions Engineering, Data Science, Infrastructure and the Data Platform teams to build new products and enhance our existing suite of products.

This is a remote, US-based role.

Technologies

React, Golang, Python, PostgreSQL (RDS), Docker, AWS technologies (Lambda, Cognito and other standard technologies)

Responsibilities

  • Code, test, debug, document, and ship and maintain software applications using established coding standards and methodologies
  • Designing and building out API’s that will be consumed by the UI to surface application data.
  • Partner with product management to drive agile delivery of both existing and new products based on project requirements, UX design, and industry best practices
  • Ensure new software meets quality standards by writing unit and end-to-end automated tests
  • Work with product, data, and other stakeholders to analyze usage and product metrics to inform key strategic decisions
  • Troubleshoot, debug, resolve product issues as they arise
  • Work cross functionally to resolve complex partner problems
  • Ensure platform and services meet SLA requirements; on call rotation for production issues, along with the rest of engineering

Requirements

  • 6+ years of software development experience building enterprise or consumer facing products
  • Experience with building API based products using python, golang or similar technologies
  • Experience with modern front-end JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular
  • Experience with RDBMS (e.g. postgres) and ability to write efficient queries with optimal structures is a big plus
  • Experience with Docker and AWS technologies is a plus
  • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills, interpersonal skills and a sense of humor (enjoy the journey)
  • Experience working in a scrum / Agile development environment
  • Familiarity working in Financial Services is a big plus
  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must live in the United States

Compensation

  • $180,000/year - $230,000/year + equity + benefits

Note: This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels, and the actual base salary within that range will be determined by several components including but not limited to the individual's experience, skills, and qualifications.

Perks

  • Employer paid group health insurance for you and your dependents
  • 401(k) plan with employer match (or equivalent for non US-based roles)
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Regular company-wide in-person events
  • Home office stipend, and more!

Corporate Values

  • Follow Through
  • Deep Understanding
  • Whatever It Takes
  • Do Something Smart

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com.

Job Description Summary

Location

South Tampa, FL – Hybrid (3 days on‑site, 2 days remote).

About Draper

Draper’s Full‑Stack Group builds mission‑critical web applications for military, government, and commercial customers. We operate like an incubator, giving engineers space to experiment, iterate, and deliver software that protects lives and advances the national interest.

Why It Matters

As a mid-level engineer, you’ll get hands‑on experience building software that powers national‑security missions. Working under senior mentors, you’ll rapidly grow technical depth while contributing code that goes live in real customer environments.

Core Responsibilities

  • Develop features and fix bugs under guidance of senior staff using React + TypeScript and a back‑end language (Node.js/Python).
  • Write unit and integration tests; adopt test‑driven development practices.
  • Participate in daily stand‑ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Review code with peers, absorb architectural guidance, and gradually own small components or services.
  • Support deployment pipelines and monitor production health (logs, alerts).

Required Qualifications

  • 2‑4 years professional full‑stack development (or 3+ years strong personal/project experience).
  • Ability to obtain an Active Secret clearance (existing Secret clearance preferred).
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, React basics, and a server‑side language (Node.js, Python, or Java).
  • Familiarity with Git and issue‑tracking tools (Jira, GitLab, etc.).
  • BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to Docker containers and simple `docker‑compose` workflows.
  • Experience with a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, Azure) through projects or labs.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs and basic authentication (OAuth).
  • Demonstrated curiosity: open‑source contributions, hackathon projects, or a technical blog.

About You

  • Insatiable appetite to learn new technologies and share knowledge.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and forging clear paths to success.
  • Passionate about building products you’d proudly use yourself.
  • Thrives in a team that pushes each other to excel daily.

The description below provides further information on Draper's view of its mid-level (MTS-2) staff members.

Duties/Responsibilities

Job Description:

  • Independently execute task assignments under the some oversight of program leadership and/or senior staff.
  • Designs algorithms using modern theory and proven techniques, adheres to software best practices.
  • Analyzes designs to demonstrate performance and functionality.
  • Develops and executes software tests to check compliance with requirements.
  • Prepares technical data, procedures, reports, drawings, manuals, and other required documentation.
  • Communicates with customers and stakeholders to establish requirements and describe the design and deliverables.
  • Identify challenges and risks associated with assigned tasks and communicate them to project leadership.
  • Drives solutions to complex problems with limited direction - contribute to requirements development, propose unique solutions, and adapt appropriately to changes in requirements.
  • Provides insight and suggest adaptations or modifications to processes and/or applications based on quantitative data or results.
  • Identifies project technical risks and mitigation strategies.

Skills/Abilities

  • Curiosity-driven approach to solving complex, customer-driven problems as part of a multi-disciplinary team.
  • Demonstrate an ability to learn new programming languages and technologies quickly.
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively and openly with multi-disciplinary program team members, program leadership, and non-technical personnel.
  • A team player able to work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to balance multiple competing tasks and demands.

Education

Requires a bachelor's in Computer Science or other related field. Master's degree is preferred.

Experience

3-5 years experience in Software Engineering or related field.

Location: Hercules, California

Experience: 0–3 Years (Freshers with Relevant Projects Encouraged)


Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field from a recognized U.S. institution.
  • Schooling must be from the United States.
  • Recent graduates with strong academic projects, internships, or research experience are encouraged to apply.

40

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

Job Overview:

As an AVP, Full Stack Developer at LPL Financial, you will be a key contributor to designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable financial technology solutions. You will work across the entire software development life cycle, from front-end user interfaces to back-end services and database interactions, ensuring high-quality and performant applications that meet business needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain full-stack applications using a variety of technologies, including front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js), back-end languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#), and database systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB).
  • Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and other developers to understand requirements, design technical solutions, and estimate effort.
  • Write clean, efficient, well-documented, and testable code following best practices and architectural patterns.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, consistency, and adherence to standards.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Troubleshoot and debug production issues, providing timely resolutions and root cause analysis.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for development processes, tools, and methodologies.
  • Mentor junior developers and share knowledge within the team.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends.


AI Awareness & Design Expectations:

  • Using AI copilots (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity) to accelerate development
  • Applying LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) for code generation, review, refactoring, debugging
  • Familiarity with Figma for design collaboration
  • Understanding responsible AI usage including data privacy and security
  • Understanding how to deploy agents to production scale using AWS Bedrock, Vercel, etc.


What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in full-stack software development.
  • Experience in at least one modern front-end framework (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js) and associated technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Experience with at least one back-end programming language (e.g., Java, Python, C#) and relevant frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, .NET Core, Django, Flask).


Core Competencies:

  • Solid understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases, including schema design, querying, and optimization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Experience in the financial services industry is a plus.


Pay Range:

$140,500.00 - $234,100.00

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

companyDescription: SentiLink, the leading provider of innovative identity and risk solutions, empowers institutions and individuals to transact confidently with one another by preventing synthetic fraud, identity theft, and emerging forms of first party fraud at the point of account application. Its solutions enable these secure transactions by leveraging a deep understanding of identity and risk, and are informed by machine learning models and insights from a team of top risk analysts. SentiLink proudly serves a broad array of financial institutions, from the largest U.S. banks to leading credit unions and fintech unicorns to help stop fraud at account opening and beyond. Headquartered in San Francisco, the company was founded in 2017 by Naftali Harris and Max Blumenfeld and it has raised $85M to date from investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Craft Ventures, and NYCA Partners, among others.
companySlogan: Your fraud and risk partner
descriptionHtml:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role

Let's introduce ourselves

Software Engineer - Full Stack Devloper, Web

Mahwah, NJ (on-site)

The Web Engineering teams sit within our Digital organization and are responsible for the end-to-end delivery of customer and retailer web experiences across the Americas. VolvoCars.com supports public customer journeys, while retailer websites is inclusive of but not limited to supporting inventory, dealer and collision-center location, lead forms, and the platforms and integrations that connect customers with retailers.

As a Software Engineer, Full Stack Web, you work as part of one engineering team across regional and global partners to build secure, reliable, accessible, and scalable web products. You contribute hands-on development across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, integrations, and supporting delivery pipelines.

You are responsible for delivering well-designed, tested, and maintainable software across our web products. You work independently on well-defined features, collaborate with senior engineers on larger technical designs, participate in code reviews, and contribute to improvements in software quality, reliability, developer experience, and deployment velocity.

Because the role contributes from discovery through production support, you are expected to understand both the customer and business needs and the technical requirements of your work. This includes customer journeys, web architecture, APIs, cloud services, data flows, third-party integrations, security, accessibility, and operational dependencies within your scope.

What You'll Do

Build Full-Stack Web Experiences

  • Develop and maintain customer and retailer web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, APIs, databases, and cloud services.
  • Translate product, UX, and business requirements into accessible, responsive, performant, and maintainable web experiences.
  • Build reusable frontend components, backend services, integrations, and API contracts that support web capabilities across the Americas.
  • Participate in technical design, estimation, implementation planning, code reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

Deliver Quality Products with Speed and Accountability

  • Own assigned engineering work across the delivery lifecycle, from refinement and implementation through testing, deployment, production support, and iterative improvement.
  • Ensure features are reviewed, tested, documented, secure, observable, and production-ready before release.
  • Use automated testing, CI/CD, feature flags, security scanning, and operational-readiness practices to improve quality and deployment velocity.
  • Identify delivery risks, dependencies, incidents, and technical debt early, and take action with the team to protect timelines and customer experience.
  • Support modernization and the retirement of redundant or legacy web-platform capabilities.

Collaborate as One Regional and Global Team

  • Work closely with engineering, product, UX, QA, analytics, security, accessibility, data, retailer, platform, and global stakeholders to clarify scope, ownership, priorities, and release expectations.
  • Contribute to technical design reviews and communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to engineering leads and cross-functional partners.
  • Coordinate with shared platform teams, Salesforce, mobile, data, and external suppliers when products depend on common services or integrations.
  • Identify ownership gaps, integration issues, and duplicated capabilities, and help implement practical solutions that improve maintainability and delivery.
  • Maintain useful technical documentation, runbooks, implementation notes, and onboarding materials.
  • Support production troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.

Provide Technical and Operational Ownership

  • Apply sound engineering judgment across modern full-stack web systems, including React, TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, databases, cloud services, caching, observability, and automated delivery pipelines.
  • Make implementation decisions with attention to scalability, resilience, performance, maintainability, cost, security, accessibility, and customer impact.
  • Use production, quality, and flow data to improve reliability, developer experience, and delivery effectiveness.
  • Contribute through constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and mentoring of junior engineers when appropriate.

What You'll Bring

  • A minimum of 3 years of professional software-engineering experience, including hands-on experience building and maintaining full-stack web applications in a collaborative product environment.
  • Practical experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, APIs, databases, automated testing, CI/CD, Git workflows, and production troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of web architecture, distributed systems, cloud platforms, security, accessibility, observability, and operational support practices.
  • Ability to independently deliver well-defined engineering work while collaborating effectively across product, design, QA, platform, security, and business teams.
  • Strong analytical judgment, problem-solving, decision-making, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience in automotive digital commerce, retailer systems, inventory, lead management, customer web journeys, or a comparable enterprise digital-product environment is preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Salary Range

  • $105,525 to $182,091

Compensation is determined based on experience, qualifications, internal equity, location and company guidelines

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

First American Trust helps individuals and businesses protect, manage, and grow what matters most through banking, wealth management, and trust solutions backed by more than ﬁve decades of experience. As an OCC-regulated federal savings bank with more than $9 billion in assets, First American Trust is comprised of two distinct divisions: banking services, and wealth management services. We provide commercial deposit services tailored to the real estate and title industries. Our wealth management division has provided personalized investment management, fiduciary trust services, and wealth planning for over six decades. You'll work alongside experienced professionals who build lasting relationships, provide thoughtful financial guidance, and help clients achieve their long-term financial goals with confidence. Along the way, you'll have the freedom and support to innovate, collaborate, and grow professionally alongside people who genuinely care about your success.

What We Do

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to design and implement secure, scalable, cloud-native software solutions that power next-generation financial applications. In this role, you will contribute hands-on development while supporting architecture and design decisions across modern web applications, APIs, and distributed services. If you are passionate about exploring new technologies and have a demonstrated track record of delivering innovative features and products, we would like to hear from you. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product, Architecture, UX, DevOps, and Security, to design, develop, and integrate AI-enabled capabilities such as intelligent automation, LLM-powered services, RAG-based solutions, and API-driven AI integrations. You will help translate emerging ideas into reliable, production-ready systems that deliver measurable business value. This position offers the opportunity to work with a talented team while operating autonomously with minimal supervision. A strong background in modern software development, cloud platforms, and agile methodologies is essential. Experience building, integrating, or operating AI-powered applications, and using AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery, is highly valued.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable applications in an Azure cloud environment.

Company Description

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

Job Description

The Opportunity:

Fandango 360 is a customer analytics and audience management platform that gives movie studios the tools to build, analyze, and distribute audiences across leading advertising platforms. As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will help build and evolve the systems that power audience creation, segmentation, estimation, distribution, and conversion measurement across Fandango’s advertising technology ecosystem.

This role will own features end-to-end, from Node.js Lambda APIs and PostgreSQL data models to the Angular frontend used by studio clients. You will contribute to platform integrations, server-side event pipelines, compliance-related data workflows, and infrastructure improvements that support scale, reliability, privacy, and performance.

Why This Role Matters: This role directly supports Fandango’s ability to help studio partners reach and understand audiences more effectively. Your work will enable new advertising platform integrations, strengthen customer analytics capabilities, and improve the reliability of critical audience and conversion workflows.

This is a remote role, with opportunities for in-person collaboration, team connection, and business-critical meetings approximately 10% of the time.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain end-to-end platform integrations, including Conversion API and Targeting Connector capabilities for new and existing advertising partners.
  • Develop and evolve Lambda-based REST APIs that support audience creation, segmentation, estimation, and distribution across multiple ad platforms.
  • Maintain and enhance server-side event pipelines that route purchase and engagement data to advertising platform conversion endpoints.
  • Implement deletion, opt-out, and compliance-related data feeds in alignment with privacy requirements such as GDPR and CCPA.
  • Deliver frontend features in Angular, NgRx, RxJS, and TypeScript for new channels, distribution flows, dashboards, and client-facing platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to infrastructure and delivery improvements using AWS, Terraform, Serverless Framework, Jenkins, Docker, and emerging GitHub Actions workflows.

Qualifications

What You Bring:

  • Senior-level fullstack engineering experience, with the ability to own technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js, serverless Lambda APIs, asynchronous patterns, REST API design, and third-party API integrations.
  • Working experience with Python 3.x, including the ability to review, debug, or support ETL scripts, AWS Glue jobs, or related data workflows.
  • Deep familiarity with AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, and Cognito.
  • Strong experience designing and optimizing PostgreSQL-backed data models, writing performant SQL, applying effective indexing strategies, and using Sequelize ORM to support reliable application workflows.
  • Experience building production-ready frontend features with Angular, TypeScript, NgRx, and RxJS, including integration with backend APIs and distributed data workflows.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch, including query design, aggregations, and performance considerations.
  • Comfort working with infrastructure and CI/CD tools such as Terraform, Serverless Framework, Docker, Jenkins, Git, and GitHub Actions.
  • A practical understanding of AWS cost management, resource efficiency, and basic FinOps principles.
  • A collaborative engineering mindset grounded in Trust, with sound judgment, accountability, and care for production-quality work.
  • A commitment to Teamwork, including partnering with product, QA, data engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver durable solutions.
  • Clear Transparency in technical communication, tradeoff discussions, documentation, and risk escalation.
  • Strong Agility, with the ability to adapt across backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure priorities in a lean engineering environment.
  • An Entrepreneurial Spirit, bringing ownership, curiosity, and initiative to ambiguous problems and new platform opportunities.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with GitHub Actions, AWS Secrets Manager, SSM, Cypress, or AWS data services including EMR, Glue, Redshift, or Spark.
  • Familiarity with maintaining or modernizing legacy deployment and infrastructure components, including Puppet-managed configuration, Apache httpd, SPA routing, or security header management.
  • Experience partnering with data engineering teams on ETL, ML pipeline, data tier, or production workflow issues.
  • Experience supporting ad tech, marketing technology, audience management, customer analytics, privacy workflows, or high-volume event pip

Why You’ll Love It Here

At Versant, you’ll help build technology that supports trusted brands, engaged audiences, and meaningful connections across media, entertainment, sports, and digital platforms. You’ll have the opportunity to work on high-impact systems used by studio partners while collaborating with a lean, experienced team that values ownership, clarity, and thoughtful execution.

This remote role offers flexibility while still creating opportunities for in-person collaboration, planning, and team connection approximately 10% of the time. You’ll be part of an environment that supports strong engineering practices, cross-functional partnerships, and opportunities to shape technical direction as the platform continues to evolve.

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com.

VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We include a good faith pay range for each position to comply with applicable state and local pay transparency laws and to promote equity across our organization. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location and may include additional forms of compensation and benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, etc.

VERSANT Media is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by VERSANT as a result of the referral or through other means.

Responsibilities

Noblis is helping the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) manage large and complex telecommunications and information management programs that use state of the art technologies to manage enterprise infrastructure services essential to the safe and efficient operation of the largest, safest, and most complex aviation system in the world. We are seeking smart, passionate, and motivated people to join our proven team in a challenging and rewarding work environment where you will be actively engaged at the intersection of technology and operations enhancing our nation’s aviation system.

Specific Responsibilities Include

  • Working closely with the Product Owner to understand the business value of his/her needs and collaborating with a team to translate these needs into working software.
  • Working closely with the Scrum Master to improve team performance and consistently deliver quality software on time and within budget
  • Willingness and ability to operate within an Agile software development environment

  • Strive to improve yourself, team, and process through daily teamwork, communication, idea-sharing, collaboration and problem-solving
  • Recommending innovative solutions to deliver a better end product
  • Other responsibilities as needed to ensure customer and team success

Required Qualifications

  • Knowledge developing web applications using .NET/C#, HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery or similar languages.
  • Knowledge with SQL Server (or equivalent) and database development
  • Knowledge working in multi-developer teams and with source code control processes
  • Understanding of Object-Oriented principles and classical design patterns
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team on multiple tasks using Agile Scrum
  • Strong professional and interpersonal skills with emphasis on self-initiation, teamwork and follow through
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills are extremely important in order to effectively communicate with team members in remote offices
  • Positive customer service attitude
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust Clearance
  • U.S. Citizen or Green Card permanent residency (3+ years U.S. residency)
  • Ability to obtain FAA clearance

Junior Level

      • Highschool degree and an additional 4 years of relevant experience.

Senior Level

  • 6-10 years of relevant professional experience

      • Masters Degree and Three (3) years of professional relevant experience

  • Experience working with MVC frameworks
  • Experience in creating and/or consuming web services
  • Experience developing applications using JavaScript frameworks (angular.js, backbone.js, etc.)
  • Experience with data visualization and analysis
  • Interest in research and keeping up with current technology trends

Overview

Noblis and our wholly owned subsidiaries, Noblis ESI and Noblis MSD, take on some of the nation’s toughest challenges, delivering advanced solutions to our customers’ most critical missions. We bring together leading scientific, engineering, and management expertise in a culture grounded in objectivity and collaboration, ensuring our work creates lasting impact across federal missions.

We seek out individuals with a natural curiosity and desire to collaborate and learn. Noblis has earned numerous workplace awards for our culture, our commitment to employee well‑being, and our dedication to meaningful, impactful work. We also maintain a drug‑free workplace.

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us.

Our award programs acknowledge employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our service standards. Compensation: $120,000 – $130,000 Base Salary + Benefits

Location: Fully Remote (Option to work hybrid out of our Venice, CA office)

About SonoSim & The Role

At SonoSim, we create user-friendly digital experiences that transform medical education and improve healthcare outcomes. Our engineering team is a bright, motivated, and highly collaborative group. We partner closely across product and design stakeholders to deliver high-quality software that solves real-world needs for medical professionals and institutions.

We are seeking a mid-level Full Stack Software Engineer (4+ years experience) to build, ship, and scale core features across the SonoSim LMS platform. Working alongside Lead, Senior, and Junior Engineers, you will navigate between projects and repositories with minimal oversight. You thrive in modern, AI-assisted development workflows and enjoy driving features from database schema design to polished user interfaces.

Core Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Feature Delivery: Own features across our primary stack—from database schema design and migrations in Prisma to backend logic (Express, tRPC) and modern UI delivery (Angular with Signals).
  • Cross-Service Integration: Maintain cross-service awareness and navigate legacy services (Python, Django, GraphQL, REST APIs) as needed.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering Velocity: Leverage AI tools (Kiro, Claude, Codex) for rapid prototyping and boilerplate generation, applying human oversight for code quality and architectural standards.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Ensure end-to-end feature integrity by validating API-to-UI handshakes, covering edge cases, and delivering maintainable code adhering to DRY/SOLID principles.
  • Agile Teamwork & Practices: Maintain shared documentation and actively participate in team ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, code reviews) to foster continuous improvement.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional full-stack web development experience with demonstrated autonomy across multiple repositories.
  • Frontend & Backend Expertise: Hands-on experience with Angular and Node.js backends (Express).
  • APIs & ORMs: Proficiency with type-safe APIs (tRPC), ORMs (Prisma), and relational database management/migrations.
  • Legacy Support: Familiarity with REST, Python, Django, and/or GraphQL for service maintenance.
  • AI Tooling & Review: Comfort using AI-assisted coding tools paired with critical code review skills.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Strong communication skills with a team-first, pragmatic mindset for collaborative development.
