Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

Job Overview:

As an AVP, Full Stack Developer at LPL Financial, you will be a key contributor to designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable financial technology solutions. You will work across the entire software development life cycle, from front-end user interfaces to back-end services and database interactions, ensuring high-quality and performant applications that meet business needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain full-stack applications using a variety of technologies, including front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js), back-end languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#), and database systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB).
  • Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and other developers to understand requirements, design technical solutions, and estimate effort.
  • Write clean, efficient, well-documented, and testable code following best practices and architectural patterns.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, consistency, and adherence to standards.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Troubleshoot and debug production issues, providing timely resolutions and root cause analysis.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for development processes, tools, and methodologies.
  • Mentor junior developers and share knowledge within the team.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends.


AI Awareness & Design Expectations:

  • Using AI copilots (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity) to accelerate development
  • Applying LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) for code generation, review, refactoring, debugging
  • Familiarity with Figma for design collaboration
  • Understanding responsible AI usage including data privacy and security
  • Understanding how to deploy agents to production scale using AWS Bedrock, Vercel, etc.


What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in full-stack software development.
  • Experience in at least one modern front-end framework (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js) and associated technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Experience with at least one back-end programming language (e.g., Java, Python, C#) and relevant frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, .NET Core, Django, Flask).


Core Competencies:

  • Solid understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases, including schema design, querying, and optimization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Experience in the financial services industry is a plus.


Pay Range:

$140,500.00 - $234,100.00

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. Are you a full-stack engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and building solutions that make data more accessible and useful?

We’re looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our Document Analytics team and help build modern, secure, and scalable technology solutions.

In this role, you’ll work across the full software development lifecycle, from solution design and hands-on development through testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support. You’ll build user-facing applications, APIs, integrations, and data-driven capabilities that help connect users with meaningful information and analytical insights.

This is a highly collaborative role where you’ll partner with engineers, architects, analytics professionals, product teams, operations, designers, and business stakeholders to turn real business needs into reliable technical solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain modern full-stack applications using React, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML, and CSS on the front end.
  • Develop reliable, scalable, and secure backend services using Go, C#, and/or Java.
  • Design and develop RESTful APIs, services, and integrations that enable access to data and analytical capabilities.
  • Build and maintain efficient database solutions, including working with PostgreSQL/Postgres and other data technologies.
  • Partner with product managers, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with UX/design partners to deliver intuitive, high-quality user experiences.
  • Assess technical requirements, recommend solution options, and provide reasonable development and delivery estimates.
  • Troubleshoot complex application and production issues and contribute to effective root-cause resolution.
  • Develop unit and integration tests to maintain application reliability and code quality.
  • Participate in code reviews, pair programming, and other collaborative engineering practices.
  • Work with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies to support scalable application deployment.
  • Use modern development tools, including GitHub Copilot, to improve engineering productivity and quality.
  • Continuously explore new technologies and development practices that can improve our products and engineering environment.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated experience building both front-end and back-end applications.
  • Strong hands-on experience with React and JavaScript/TypeScript, along with HTML and CSS.
  • Professional backend development experience using at least one of the following: Go/Golang, strongly preferred C#/.NET Java
  • Experience designing, developing, and consuming APIs and web services.
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering principles, application architecture, testing, and maintainable code.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including experience investigating and resolving complex technical issues.
  • Ability to evaluate requirements, recommend technical approaches, and estimate level of effort.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • A continuous-learning mindset and willingness to challenge existing approaches constructively.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Go/Golang in production environments.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL/Postgres or comparable relational databases.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or other cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
  • Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience with Git/GitHub and modern source-control practices.
  • Experience with engineering and project-tracking tools such as Jira.
  • Experience developing data-intensive, analytics, or document-processing applications.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll bring genuine full-stack engineering capability, comfortably moving between a modern React front end and backend services and APIs. You’ll be someone who can take a problem from requirements through implementation, testing, and production, while collaborating closely with the people around you.

Most importantly, you’ll be curious, pragmatic, and motivated by building technology that is secure, scalable, maintainable, and useful.

When You Join Our Team

  • We’ll empower you to learn, grow, and build the career you want.
  • You’ll work in a collaborative environment where different perspectives and ideas are valued.
  • You’ll have opportunities to work with modern technologies and contribute directly to meaningful engineering challenges.
  • As part of a global team, you’ll help shape technology solutions that support the future of the organization.

The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.

The Opportunity

Are you passionate about building innovative applications that solve complex mission challenges? CACI is seeking a skilled and motivated Application Engineer to join our team in Laurel, MD. In this role, you will help modernize and enhance critical intelligence systems by developing new applications, automating business processes, and improving how mission information is delivered and consumed.

Working closely with customers and technical teams, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable software solutions that improve operational efficiency, increase situational awareness, and accelerate mission outcomes. This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful work at the forefront of technology while supporting our nation's intelligence community.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain modern applications, software tools, and reusable components that support mission-critical operations.
  • Create innovative solutions that automate internal tracking, data collection, and information-sharing processes.
  • Analyze requirements and translate them into technical designs, specifications, and implementation plans.
  • Develop and support software using industry-standard engineering practices, design methodologies, and development tools.
  • Evaluate existing applications and identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Estimate development effort, project timelines, and resource requirements.
  • Design and implement cloud-native, distributed systems that support high availability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to modernize legacy environments and accelerate the delivery of mission information.
  • Develop and integrate APIs, databases, and supporting infrastructure to enable secure and efficient data exchange.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active TS/SCI w/ Polygraph
  • Education & Experience: All education and experience must be in a technical discipline directly related to the position. Degrees, diplomas, and certifications must be earned from accredited institutions.
    • High School Diploma/GED with 12+ years of relevant experience, OR
    • Associate's Degree with 10+ years of relevant experience, OR
    • Bachelor's Degree with 8+ years of relevant experience, OR
    • Master's Degree with 6+ years of relevant experience, OR
    • Doctorate Degree with 4+ years of relevant experience.
Software Development

  • Strong production-level experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Experience developing applications using modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue.js, and/or Angular.
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, Sass/SCSS/Less, and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with modern build tools and package managers, including Vite, Webpack, Babel, npm, pnpm, and/or Yarn.
  • Experience developing and maintaining unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.
  • Knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG) and frontend performance optimization techniques.

System Architecture

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable, high-availability, cloud-native distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of API design and integration, including REST, gRPC, and WebSockets.
  • Experience implementing caching and content delivery strategies using technologies such as Redis, Memcached, and CDNs.

Data Management

  • Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL.
  • Experience working with NoSQL and document databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, and Elasticsearch.

Cloud & DevOps

  • Experience designing and deploying solutions in AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Kustomize.

Desired

Additional Programming Experience

  • Experience with Python, Golang, and/or Java.

Security, Reliability & Observability

  • Experience implementing logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing solutions using tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or the ELK Stack.
  • Knowledge of authentication and authorization technologies, including OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, PKI, mTLS, CORS, and data encryption.
  • Experience designing resilient systems using strategies such as rate limiting, circuit breakers, graceful degradation, and disaster recovery planning.

Engineering Practices

  • Advanced proficiency with Git and collaborative development platforms such as GitHub or GitLab.
  • Commitment to software engineering best practices, code quality, automated testing, and continuous improvement.

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

$103,800 - $218,100

Craftbridge Digital builds and repairs business software. A project might involve replacing a shared spreadsheet with an internal application, investigating rejected API records or moving a database to a new system.

For connected applications, we define what the fields mean and how rejected transfers are handled. descriptionHtml:
Craftbridge Digital builds web apps, API integrations and automation scripts for businesses, and keeps their older software running. We're based in Austin.

We're hiring a Software Engineer. Full-time, remote from anywhere in the United States.

A typical ticket: a client's order form has to push data into their accounting system, and nobody wrote down how the old sync worked.

You read the code that's there, write the new piece, test it against a copy of their data and ship it with a short note on what changed.

Most of our work is TypeScript and Node on the back end, React on the front and Postgres or SQL Server underneath. Some clients still run PHP or C#. You'll touch those too.

Every change goes through code review. You review other people's pull requests and they review yours.

You've shipped code in at least one of those languages, at work, in an internship or in a project we can look at.

You use Git and can write a SQL query with a join.

You've called a REST API from code and handled what comes back when it fails.

Nice if you've written tests, used Docker or worked with the Stripe, QuickBooks or Salesforce APIs.

Benefits: medical, dental and vision for you and your family, a 401(k) with a company match, paid time off and sick days, a yearly learning budget, plus a laptop and home office gear.

What we read first: your CV, then a repo or something you built. A few lines on the hardest bug you fixed are plenty.

Craftbridge Digital is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

Our vision is to be a premier finance company and lender of choice known for its People, Performance and Service.

Job Description

Job Summary

The Senior Full-Stack Developer is a full-stack developer who is responsible for solution design, development, and delivery. This role maintains a high proficiency level in all layers of solution architecture including data, business, WebAPI, and client UI. This role will leverage research and problem-solving skills to deliver innovative technology solutions to meet business objectives and timelines while contributing to architectural and internal improvement projects. Additionally, the Senior Full-Stack Developer will possess holistic, system-based and forward-looking approach to technical processes for pushing code within the IT organization.

Job Duties

  • Leads the execution of design, build, development, and delivery of software solutions both for internal and external users, leveraging a SQL Server / C# .Net WebAPI / Angular UI platform. Deliver integrated solutions by collaborating on solution design, configuring systems, creating documentation for on-going operational needs and future maintenance.
  • Responsible for the design, documentation, analysis, testing, deployment, and maintenance of product code. Assists team members and department with other deliverables, as required. Build critical working relationships with IT business groups.
  • Mentors and transfer knowledge to new and existing junior developers. Articulate and communicate best practices on projects to ensure quality and timely delivery.
  • Designs, coordinates, and facilitates product UI / UX design and product prototyping sessions with team and business sponsors.
  • Support the architectural analysis to determine opportunities for improvement. Contributes to development on architecture processes and standards system improvements.
  • Learns and takes ownership as the technical SME to support automation activities including CI/CD, DevOps, and Unit Testing.
  • Actively and creatively support product deployments and production incidents as needed.
  • Promotes and exhibits a constructive, positive team environment by maintaining a spirit of openness, collaboration, information sharing, respect, learning, and support for our common goal.
  • Other duties as assigned

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field of study
  • 10+ years designing and developing .Net WebAPI / Angular UI Web Applications
  • 10+ years C# .Net Development - C# / .Net 4.x / Core / EntityFramework 6+ / WebAPI
  • 6+ years of Angular UI Development - TypeScript / Angular 7+ / JavaScript / CSS / HTML5
  • 6+ years UI / UX product team UI design and UI prototyping
  • 6+ years Database design and development: SQL Server / T-SQL Script
  • Expertise in software design (SOLID), enterprise architecture patterns, and integrated, full-stack, responsive Web and Web Mobile UI solutions
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to solve challenging problems in an efficient, maintainable, and flexible way.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects and problems simultaneously with minimal supervision.
  • Proven ability to build strong, cohesive partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Preferred Experience with:
  • Azure: Azure DevOps / Serverless Functions / Business Functions / Cloud Data
  • JavaScript Unit Testing frameworks: Karma / Mocha / Jasmine

Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate including

Skill Set, Experience, Qualifications And Other Job-related Reasons.

The pay range for this role is $114,400.00 - $157,100.00 annually.

We help essential service industries grow on autopilot.

Essential services power the real economy. Every one of us interacts with these industries repeatedly throughout our lives.

But these large businesses face real-world constraints—human labor, external volatility, compliance, logistics, and physical infrastructure. In a world where startups mostly build for startups, we serve the large enterprises in real industries and end users that keep America running. descriptionHtml:
Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America. There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.

Netic's Full-Stack Software Engineers working on the product team build the features that put AI in the hands of real businesses. This role combines technical excellence with customer empathy, crafting products that make complex AI feel simple, and deliver immediate value to essential service industries.

We need to hire multiple new graduate engineers for our core software product team that are available to start between winter of 2026 and summer of 2027. If you can start earlier - even better.

What You'll Do

  • Build agentic products: Design, code, and ship full-stack features for Netic's AI platform.
  • Co‑create with customers: Work closely with our customers to understand workflows, gather feedback, and turn pain points into features that stick.
  • Own end‑to‑end delivery: Drive projects from spec to production, handling data models, APIs, front‑end polish, and post‑launch iteration.
  • Ensure quality: Build, test, and monitor features in production to ensure reliability and performance.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven product builder: Ability to deliver user‑facing software at scale; you’ve carried features through multiple release cycles.
  • Full‑stack fluency: Comfortable with React, TypeScript, Python; experience with databases and cloud infrastructure.
  • AI experience (nice‑to‑have): Hands‑on with LLM APIs, embeddings, or RAG patterns—or hunger to learn fast.
  • Customer empathy: Track record of translating stakeholder goals into crisp technical specs and delightful products.
  • Founder‑level ownership: You run toward ambiguity, write clean code quickly, and see failures as data for the next sprint.
  • Excellent communicator: Able to explain architectural trade‑offs to engineering, and business outcomes to executives.

Our values

  • Obsess over the customer
  • Every second counts
  • Sweat the details
  • There are no blockers
  • Be self-directed
  • Seek and speak the truth
  • Enjoy the ride

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

Senior Full Stack Developer – .NET / C# / React / Angular / Azure

Build Enterprise Technology. Solve Complex Problems. Help Shape What’s Next.

Trinity Total Home is seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to design, develop, integrate, and enhance enterprise applications that support our growing business.

This is a hands-on full-stack software engineering role for a developer with strong experience across the Microsoft technology stack, including C#, .NET/.NET Core, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, React.js, Angular, TypeScript, REST APIs, SQL Server, Microsoft Azure, and Azure DevOps.

You’ll work across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—from architecture and database design through front-end development, API and enterprise integrations, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and production support. You'll also have opportunities to work with Generative AI, AI-assisted development tools, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled applications as we continue to modernize our technology environment.

If you're a hands-on developer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning new technology, and building applications that directly impact the business, we'd like to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable enterprise software applications and services.
  • Build modern web applications using C#, .NET, .NET Core/.NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, React.js, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Develop and maintain Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React.js, Angular, and modern front-end frameworks.
  • Design and develop RESTful APIs, Web APIs, web services, microservices, and integration solutions.
  • Develop secure, scalable, and maintainable applications using object-oriented programming (OOP), software design patterns, and modern application architecture principles.
  • Design, develop, and optimize Microsoft SQL Server databases, T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and database integrations.
  • Integrate applications with enterprise platforms including Salesforce, NetSuite, Contentstack, ADP, CRM, ERP, CMS, cloud platforms, and other third-party systems.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
  • Participate in software architecture, application design, and technical solution discussions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application defects, integration issues, performance problems, and production incidents.
  • Develop and execute unit, integration, and functional testing to support application quality and reliability.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards, application security, and coding best practices.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, source control, and release management using Azure DevOps and Git.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, and operational support procedures.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize applications, improve architecture, reduce technical debt, and automate business processes.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, cloud solutions, software development practices, and advancements in artificial intelligence.

AI & Intelligent Automation

As Trinity Total Home continues to expand its use of emerging technology, you'll have opportunities to:

  • Use AI-assisted software development tools to improve development speed, code quality, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.
  • Work with tools and platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar technologies.
  • Assist with the development and implementation of Generative AI, AI-enabled applications, AI agents, and intelligent automation solutions.
  • Explore opportunities to use AI and automation to improve business processes and application capabilities.
  • Apply appropriate AI governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI principles when developing or implementing AI-enabled solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience within an enterprise application environment.
  • Strong development experience with C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core/.NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, and Web API.
  • Strong front-end development experience with React.js and/or Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience developing modern Single Page Applications (SPAs) and responsive web applications.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software design patterns, application architecture, and development methodologies.
  • Experience designing, developing, and consuming RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server, database design, T-SQL, complex queries, stored procedures, and query optimization.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure cloud technologies.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, source control, CI/CD pipelines, and modern deployment practices.
  • Experience working within an Agile/Scrum software development environment.
  • Understanding of secure application development, authentication, authorization, web security, and data protection.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced technology environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience developing microservices and cloud-native applications.
  • Experience with Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure Storage Services.
  • Experience with integration platforms such as Dell Boomi and API management technologies.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Contentstack, ADP, CRM, ERP, and CMS systems.
  • Experience with Generative AI, Machine Learning, AI Agents, Intelligent Automation, or AI-enabled application development.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools.
  • Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, data privacy, and AI security.
  • Experience with application modernization, cloud migration, or legacy system transformation.
  • Microsoft, Azure, AI, or other relevant technical certifications.

Technical Leadership

This is a hands-on individual contributor role and does not have direct supervisory responsibility.

As a senior member of the development team, you may:

  • Provide technical guidance and support to junior developers.
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Assist with onboarding and mentoring new team members.
  • Share development best practices and help strengthen technical standards across the team.

Our Technology Environment

C# | .NET | .NET Core | .NET 8+ | ASP.NET Core | React.js | Angular | TypeScript | JavaScript | HTML5 | CSS3 | REST APIs | Web API | Microservices | Microsoft SQL Server | T-SQL | Azure | Azure DevOps | Azure App Services | Azure Functions | Logic Apps | Azure Storage | Git | CI/CD | Salesforce | NetSuite | Contentstack | ADP | Dell Boomi | Azure OpenAI | Generative AI | AI Agents | Intelligent Automation | Agile/Scrum

Who Will Succeed Here?

We're looking for someone who is more than a coder.

You'll thrive in this role if you're a hands-on senior developer who enjoys solving problems, understanding how systems connect, and using technology to make the business better.

You're comfortable owning a problem from initial requirements through deployment, collaborating with business stakeholders, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and helping other developers grow.

You're also curious about what's next. Whether it's cloud technology, application modernization, AI, automation, or a better way to architect a solution, you're motivated to keep learning and applying new technology in practical ways.

Physical & Work Requirements

  • Ability to work for prolonged periods at a computer.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, and through virtual collaboration platforms.
  • Ability to occasionally lift up to 15 pounds.
  • Ability to maintain focus during detailed technical analysis, coding, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities.
  • Availability for occasional extended hours during critical deployments, system upgrades, or production issue resolution.

Build better applications. Explore emerging technology. Solve meaningful problems. Help shape what's next at Trinity Total Home.

The Role

GitKraken is hiring Full Stack Product Engineers to help build GitKraken Insights, our new engineering intelligence product for software teams.

Insights helps engineering leaders understand how work actually moves through their organization: PR flow, DORA metrics, code quality, developer sentiment, AI tool adoption, agent impact, where teams are getting stuck, and how to track spend. It is a brand-new product with strong customer interest, which means there is a meaningful product surface to shape and real technical work to do.

You will work across React, Go, PostgreSQL, AWS, and GitHub-based workflows. This role is for engineers who can take an ambiguous product problem, understand the user's needs, design the technical path, and ship the feature end to end.

We are hiring across levels. What matters most is strong engineering judgment, product sense, clear communication, and the ability to build software that real developers and engineering leaders can trust.

What You'll Do

  • Turn ambiguous product ideas into scoped technical plans and working software.
  • Build interfaces that make complex engineering data understandable, trustworthy, and actionable.
  • Help shape a new product area with active customer demand and plenty of room for product judgment.
  • Build full stack product features across React, Go, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
  • Design APIs, data models, and user experiences for engineering intelligence workflows.
  • Write maintainable, tested code and participate seriously in design reviews, code reviews, and production readiness.
  • Communicate tradeoffs clearly in PRs, technical notes, and team discussions.

What You'll Bring

  • Product judgment: you can reason about users, scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs.
  • Experience building production software across frontend and backend systems.
  • Backend engineering experience, ideally with Go or the ability to ramp quickly in Go.
  • Experience designing APIs with clear contracts, validation, error handling, and sensible edge case behavior.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) as part of your day-to-day flow, with a sense of when to trust them and when not to.
  • Comfort working with Git, GitHub, pull requests, CI/CD, and code review workflows.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, SQL, migrations, and PostgreSQL fundamentals.
  • Strong React and TypeScript skills.
  • Clear written communication and a habit of making your reasoning visible.

Bonus Points

  • Product judgment: you can reason about users, scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs.
  • Clear written communication in English and a habit of making your reasoning visible.
  • Experience turning ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans and shipped product.
  • Full stack engineering experience across frontend, backend, and data.
  • React and TypeScript skills, with backend experience in Go or the ability to ramp quickly.
  • Experience using AI coding tools or agentic coding workflows to plan, build, test, review, or debug software.
  • SQL and relational data modeling fundamentals, ideally with PostgreSQL.
  • Experience designing APIs with clear contracts, validation, error handling, and thoughtful edge case behavior.
  • Comfort working with Git, GitHub, pull requests, CI/CD, and code review workflows.

How You'll Be Rewarded

  • 💵 Excellence — Competitive compensation with annual performance-based pay increases
  • 🏖 Balance — Flexible Paid-Time-Off Policy & paid company holidays (chosen by our employees)
  • 👶 Parent life — Generous paid parental leave
  • 🐶 Pets — Pet insurance plan (with no exclusions)
  • 🍎 Health — Health, dental, and vision insurance with competitive employer cost-sharing
  • 🌵 Headquarters — Modern, fully equipped offices designed to maximize productivity in a hybrid environment
  • 🏆 Culture — Great Place to Work Certified
  • 📚 Growth — Paid career development opportunities, audiobook subscriptions, and mentorship
  • 🔮 Future — 401(k) retirement plan plus company matching
  • 🛫 Travel — Company paid domestic trip after your 1-year anniversary & an international trip every 5 years

Location

This is either a fully remote position OR a hybrid position based in Scottsdale, AZ. This role combines the flexibility of remote work with the benefits of meaningful in-person collaboration. Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the Phoenix area.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At GitKraken, we believe that diversity among our teammates is critical to our success as a company. GitKraken evaluates all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender (including pregnancy, gender expression, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability status, or any other legally protected class. We recruit, hire, and retain top talent from a diverse candidate pool.

The Enterprise Solutions and Services Development team develops and supports full-stack applications for the entire organization. We work closely with our business partners in developing new applications, enhancing existing ones, and building enterprise solutions for our different business needs.   • Collaborate with the business and technical teams, develop solutions that fulfill the business requirements incorporating UMB and industry strategies, patterns, standards and technologies, and then review solutions with stakeholders for alignment.

  • Develop and review both front-end and back-end code in C# and Angular JS.
  • Create and Maintain Technical documents.
  • Mentor junior IT and Business teams on new technologies and patterns.
  • Stay current with modern technology, patterns and trends.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or related discipline and at least 5 years of enterprise solutions and API development experience OR equivalent combination of education and work experience.

    • Web development using Angular JS framework
    • SQL Server
    • Development or support of applications in AWS
    • Microservice architecture implementation

    • Exposure to CI/CI pipelines
Bonus Points if you have

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

We’re looking for a motivated, collaborative, full stack developer with 3–6 years of industry experience to join the team responsible for building and deploying our platform and web/mobile applications used by thousands of customers. Our team is made up of engineers who are passionate about creating innovative solutions with modern technology and scalable architecture. As a member of this team, your expertise will shape best practices, design patterns, and technology choices, delivering value quickly and iteratively.

You will own meaningful parts of our product and infrastructure, mentor junior engineers, and have the opportunity to influence architecture while continuing to grow your technical depth.

Team/Department Overview: Product Engineering Team – Reporting to the Manager of Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, and maintain web applications using Java, React, and TypeScript.
  • Develop APIs using RESTful and gRPC best practices, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Own features beyond initial release, including monitoring, debugging, and iterative improvements in production.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to design and implement new features aligned with customer needs.
  • Write clean, well-documented, maintainable, and efficient code using modern frameworks and best practices.
  • Debug and troubleshoot issues across the full stack, including production support and root cause analysis.
  • Contribute to and help evolve our system architecture to improve scalability and maintainability.
  • Utilize SQL and relational database tools to manage and persist application state.
  • Make informed recommendations regarding the development of new code, refactoring of existing code, and integration of third-party/open-source frameworks.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback while fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in scheduled on-call rotations to support our products in production.

Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of professional experience in a software engineering role, preferably building and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong experience with Java for back-end development, including familiarity with frameworks such as Spring Boot.
  • Proficiency in Typescript, Javascript, and React (or similar front-end frameworks) for building scalable web applications.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, relational databases, and SQL.
  • Strong grasp of data structures, client/server architecture, and the trade-offs involved in scaling applications.
  • Experience using Git, modern IDEs, and build/deployment tools (e.g., Gradle, Docker, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g GitHub Copilot, Claude Code).
  • Experience supporting production systems, including debugging, root cause analysis, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to break down complex technical problems and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Effective communication skills and a track record of collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team environment and provide guidance to peers when needed.

Compensation

The expected range for this position is $145,000 - $165,000 per year. This reflects typical earning potential in this role based on market data and individual factors including skill sets, experience, and geographic location. In addition to salary, full-time employees are eligible for an equity package and competitive benefits that support you and your family as part of your total rewards package at Flock Freight. We target candidates local or willing to relocate to Flock Freight’s San Diego headquarters.

  • Life & Benefits of the Flock:
    • Hybrid Work Model: As an organization we value in-office collaboration, working cross-functionally, and winning together. Through scheduled in-office and work from home days, we are able to work more efficiently and collaboratively.
    • 401(k): We know Flock may just be a stepping stone in your epic journey, but we want to be sure you’re setting your future self up for success!
    • Medical, Dental & Vision: Generous coverage for employees and dependents. Both HMO and PPO options provided.
Our Promise To You

Flock Freight is committed to creating an environment that’s fair and inclusive. We fill our open positions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We value the skills of people from all backgrounds and are proud to hire, promote, and retain talent from a diverse candidate pool. Diverse perspectives are central to innovation at Flock Freight and make our team better. We're interested in your inherent abilities, not just the skills you bring from your last role - if you think you have what it takes to succeed in the role but don't check every box, please still get in touch. We'd love to start a conversation with you.

Flock Freight has zero tolerance for behavior that negatively impacts marginalized groups, including women, people of color, veterans, immigrants, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQIA+ community. We invite people of all identities to join the Flock!

We are currently targeting talent in the San Diego/Encinitas area.

  • Collaborate with the development team to produce high-quality, maintainable and scalable software.
  • Maintain coding standards and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Ensure architectural principles and coding standards are maintained across the code and project lifecycles.
  • Stay current on new tools and frameworks and bring proposals to the team when they would improve HUB technical solutions and portal platforms.
  • Prepare detailed specifications from which programs will be written as well as help design, code, test, debug, document, and maintain those programs.

  • Use AI tools across the development lifecycle and help define how the team uses them, including review standards for AI-generated code and limits on what coding agents can access.
  • Diagnose and fix production issues, add monitoring and alerting, and lead blameless postmortems.
  • Build features with security in mind, including authentication, authorization and the handling of customer personal data.
  • Contribute across languages and frameworks in a polyglot engineering team as project needs change.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, a related field or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including production work in both a front-end framework and .NET.
  • Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, React (or similar), TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and SQL.
  • Experience designing and building REST APIs, including versioning, error handling and authentication.
  • Collaborate effectively as part of a polyglot engineering team, contributing across multiple languages and frameworks as project needs demand.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Can explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical business owners, lead technical discussions and drive them to a decision.
  • Ability to adapt to quickly changing business conditions.
  • Able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines and priorities
  • Has mentored other developers through code review, pairing or onboarding.
  • Experience with automated testing at the unit, integration and end-to-end level.
  • Working knowledge of web application security, including the OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC and the handling of personal data.
  • Has built and maintained CI/CD pipelines and works daily in Git with Bitbucket or GitHub or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with data modeling and query tuning in SQL Server.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, with a strong preference for Microsoft Azure (App Services, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, Azure SQL, etc.)
  • Experience building accessible, cross-browser web applications that meet WCAG 2.1 AA.
  • Experience with frontend architecture, including state management, component design and rendering performance.
  • Experience with application monitoring in Azure Application Insights or a similar tool.
  • Experience with GraphQL.
  • Experience working on Scrum teams.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent work experience

Pay transparency

descriptionHtml:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us and make mental healthcare more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand.

At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates.

You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision.

What will you do?

  • You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement.
  • You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code.
  • You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners.
  • You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs.
  • You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems.
  • You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas.
  • You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms.
  • You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code.
  • You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments.
  • You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience.
  • You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment.
  • You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks.
  • You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision.

We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software.

  • Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS
  • Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery

We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health.
  • You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business.
  • You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success.
  • You will NOT be expected to sacrifice your well-being to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, all while supporting sustainable ways of working.
  • You will NOT have to wonder why your work matters. The work we do here helps to expand access to mental health care and supports people seeking help when they need it.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.

Requirements

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Deep understanding of web development concepts and principles.
  • Examples of full-stack projects or significant product features.
  • At least one major demonstrable project that includes frontend code, backend code, and a database.
  • Ability to design, develop, and launch a web application or substantial feature from start to finish.
  • Ability to learn quickly, navigate an established codebase, and build new skills independently.
  • A strong sense of ownership and eagerness to build something meaningful.
  • Three or more years of professional web development experience in any stack, solving challenging problems and implementing new features from scratch.
  • Three or more years of experience with SQL, including relational schema design and complex queries.
  • Familiarity with web application, data, and SQL security best practices.
  • Comfort working outside the abstractions of a framework and understanding what is happening behind the scenes.
  • Experience using Git in a collaborative team environment.
  • Sound engineering judgment and a thoughtful approach to modern development tools, including AI assistants, with appropriate attention to security, privacy, and code quality.

Qualifications Expected For Position

  • Bachelor's degree + 3 years of professional experience
  • Master's + 1 year of professional experience
  • PhD + 0 years of professional experience

Bonus (Helpful, But Not Required)

  • Experience working with PHP, Laravel, or the LAMP/LEMP ecosystem.
  • Experience with React or Next.js.
  • Experience modernizing established applications or incrementally replacing legacy systems.
  • Experience working in a startup, growth-stage company, or other fast-moving environment.
  • Experience building products in health care, mental health, or another highly regulated or privacy-sensitive field.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the growth of other engineers.

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

The base salary range for this position is $110,000 - $160,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

At BetterHelp we thrive on difference and individuality, and as part of the Teladoc Health family, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status.

Notice To Candidates

BetterHelp has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team – please know that we have no affiliation or connection to these situations. We only post open roles on our career page (betterhelp.com/careers) or reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages, and all official BetterHelp recruitment emails will come from the domain @betterhelp.com. Our commitment is to ensure a safe and transparent hiring experience for all candidates. We will never ask you for money, gift cards, or any form of payment during our hiring process, and we will never send money or checks to candidates. If you experience this, it is a scam.

descriptionHtml:
About Exponent

Exponent is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges.

We are committed to engaging multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower our clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability.

Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team!  

Key statistics :

  • 1,100+ Team members
  • 950+ Consultants
  • 640+ Ph.D.s
  • 90+ Disciplines
  • 30+ Offices globally


Our Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Senior Enterprise Application Developer (Full Stack) to join our Information Technology team in any US office or remote from the US. In this role, you will work within a collaborative team of internal developers to design and deliver high-impact, business-critical applications across the full technology stack.

You will take ownership of end-to-end solution delivery, spanning modern frontend development with React, backend services in .NET, and scalable, cloud-native architectures on Amazon Web Services.

This role includes responsibility for system architecture, technical leadership, and hands-on development, with a strong emphasis on building and integrating AI-driven solutions, including applications powered by large language models and modern AI platforms.

You will partner closely with business stakeholders and engineering teams to translate complex requirements into scalable, maintainable systems that deliver measurable value to the organization.

You will be responsible for

Full Stack Development

  • Design and build modern, responsive web applications using React and related ecosystems
  • Develop robust, scalable backend services using .NET / ASP.NET Core
  • Own features end-to-end, from user experience and frontend implementation to API design, data access, and persistence
  • Build intuitive, high-performance interfaces that enable complex workflows and data interactions


AI-Driven Application Development

  • Design and implement applications leveraging LLMs and modern AI tooling
  • Integrate AI into core business workflows, including:
    • Document processing
    • Intelligent automation
    • Advanced data analysis
  • Utilize modern AI platforms (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI APIs) to deliver production-grade solutions
  • Apply AI/ML techniques to enhance application capabilities, improve efficiency, and unlock new business value

Cloud & Serverless Architecture

  • Architect, build, and deploy scalable, cloud-native solutions on Amazon Web Services
  • Design and implement event-driven and serverless systems, leveraging services such as:
    • AWS Lambda
    • Step Functions
    • ECS
    • S3, EventBridge, SQS
    • Bedrock/Agent Core
  • Ensure systems are resilient, cost-efficient, and optimized for performance at scale
  • Apply best practices for distributed systems, observability, and fault tolerance

Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Lead the design and development of scalable, mission-critical systems, including N-tier architectures
  • Define and evolve system architecture across frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure
  • Interface directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate needs into technical solutions, and ensure alignment with business objectives
  • Provide technical leadership across projects, guiding design decisions and ensuring engineering excellence
  • Mentor developers and foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and high-quality delivery


Engineering Excellence & Delivery

  • Apply best practices such as SOLID principles and modern architectural patterns
  • Operate within Agile SDLC frameworks (Scrum, Kanban) to deliver high-quality, maintainable solutions
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and Azure DevOps, enabling automated testing and reliable deployments
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve developer productivity, automate testing, and enhance code quality
  • Implement secure coding practices aligned with industry standards (e.g., OWASP), including input validation, authentication/authorization, data protection, and vulnerability mitigation
  • Ensure applications meet security, compliance, and data protection requirements across all layers of the system
  • Oversee the ongoing support, performance optimization, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications


You Will Have The Following Skills And Qualifications

Full Stack Expertise

  • Strong experience building modern web applications with React (or similar frontend frameworks)
  • Deep expertise in backend development using .NET / ASP.NET Core
  • Proven ability to design and implement scalable system architectures, RESTful APIs, and cloud-integrated applications


Cloud & AWS

  • Extensive experience designing and deploying solutions on AWS
  • Strong hands-on experience with serverless architectures and event-driven systems
  • Experience building and operating cloud-native applications in production environments


Architecture & Systems Design

  • Proven experience designing distributed, scalable systems
  • Strong understanding of microservices, event-driven architectures, and system integration patterns
  • Ability to balance performance, scalability, maintainability, and cost in system design


AI & Modern Tooling

  • Experience integrating AI/ML or LLM-based solutions into enterprise applications
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI, or similar
  • Experience using AI tools to enhance software development workflows


Data & Persistence

  • Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, RDS)
  • Expertise in data modeling, query optimization, and database performance tuning


DevOps & Agile

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices (GitHub, Azure DevOps)
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and iterative delivery


Leadership

  • Excellent leadership, mentorship, and communication skills
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and deliver results in dynamic environments


Presently legally authorized to work in the United States; no immigration sponsorship or processing required.

Life @ Exponent

To learn more about life at Exponent and our impact, please visit the following links:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

https://www.exponent.com/company/our-impact

Attracting, inspiring, developing, and rewarding exceptional people with diverse backgrounds and expertise are central to our corporate culture. Our diverse team allows us to provide better value to our clients and enjoy an enriched work environment.

Our firm is committed to offering a variety of programs and resources to support health and well-being. We believe that providing competitive benefits as well as compensation and recognition programs empowers our staff to do work that makes a difference.

Work Environment

At Exponent, we have found that in-person interactions deepen employee engagement and are crucial for development, for realizing the full potential of our talented and diverse teams, and for building a more inclusive workplace where all have a sense of belonging. In our offices, you can expect a supportive culture and a collaborative, dynamic, multi-disciplinary work environment.

USD $135,000.00 - USD $180,000.00 /Yr.

Benefits You Will Enjoy

Access benefits information on our Life@Exponent page:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may email us at HR-Accommodations@exponent.com .

descriptionHtml:
Overview

REI Systems’ mission is to deliver reliable, innovative technology solutions that advance Federal clients' missions and exceed their expectations. Our technologists and consultants are passionate about solving complex challenges that impact millions of lives. We take a Mindful Modernization® approach in delivering our services, including application modernization, grants management, case management systems, government data analytics, and advisory services. This approach, the REI Way, ensures mission impact by aligning our clients' strategic objectives with measurable outcomes through people, processes, and technology.

We offer the same commitment to our employees by providing professional development, meaningful projects, and flexibility to spend time with family and friends. We believe employees are at their best when fulfilled in both their professional careers and their personal lives. Learn more at www.REIsystems.com.

Employees voted REI Systems a Washington Post Top Workplace in 2015, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025!

Responsibilities

Position Overview

REI Systems is seeking a Junior Software Engineer to develop and maintain modern full stack applications supporting the ODOS Program. The successful candidate will work with experienced engineers, product owners, analysts, designers, testers, and DevOps professionals to deliver reliable, secure, and user-focused software. This role is ideal for an early-career developer who has a strong foundation in Java and modern web development and is eager to grow within an Agile and DevSecOps environment.

Responsibilities

Full Stack Development

  • Develop and maintain full stack web applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, React, and JavaScript.
  • Develop backend business logic and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build responsive and reusable user interfaces using Angular, React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Integrate front-end applications with backend APIs, databases, and enterprise services.
  • Develop and maintain applications using PostgreSQL, Oracle SQL, and other relational database technologies.
  • Write and maintain SQL queries and support application data models and integrations.
  • Develop clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code following established software engineering standards.
  • Troubleshoot application defects and integration issues with support from senior team members.


Testing CI CD and Production Support

  • Develop unit and integration tests to improve application quality and reliability.
  • Participate in automated testing using tools such as JUnit, Cucumber, and Selenium.
  • Use Git and GitHub for source control, branching, collaboration, and code reviews.
  • Work with Jenkins and CI/CD pipelines to build and deploy applications.
  • Collaborate with DevOps engineers to support deployments across development, test, staging, and production environments.
  • Use Splunk and New Relic to review application logs, monitor application behavior, and assist with triaging production incidents and performance issues.
  • Support defect remediation and secure software development activities.


Collaboration

  • Work with product owners, business analysts, UX designers, QA engineers, architects, DevOps engineers, and other developers.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, design discussions, code reviews, and technical troubleshooting sessions.
  • Learn and apply established software development, DevSecOps, testing, and engineering practices.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of professional software development experience.
  • Experience or strong foundational knowledge of Java.
  • Experience developing applications using Spring Boot or similar Java frameworks.
  • Experience with Angular, React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs and relational databases.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle SQL, or comparable relational databases.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitHub and modern source-control practices.
  • Familiarity with automated testing and CI/CD concepts.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to Jenkins or other CI/CD technologies.
  • Experience with Splunk, New Relic, or comparable monitoring and observability tools.
  • Familiarity with microservices and cloud-native application development.
  • Familiarity with Agile and DevSecOps practices.


Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Clearance: Candidate must be able to obtain and maintain public trust Clearance, US CITIZEN needed.

Location: Hybrid (2 Day per week in our Sterling, VA office on Tuesday and Wednesday)

Compensation & Benefits:

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position in Sterling, VA is $77,000 – $93,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.

In addition to competitive compensation, REI Systems offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings benefits; ESOP; paid time off; professional development opportunities; and other programs designed to support our employees' overall well-being.

EEO Statement: REI Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Sr Software Engineer

We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future

We are seeking a talented Sr Software Engineer to join our team. This role involves designing, developing, testing, and deploying software applications. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Your Responsibilities On The Team

Key Responsibilities:

Software Development:


  • Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications, ensuring scalability, performance, and security.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, following best practices and coding standards.
  • Work on both the front-end using React and back-end (using technologies such as Node.js, Python, or .NET).


Architecture and Design:


  • Contribute to the architecture and design of software systems, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical strategy.
  • Participate in technical design reviews, providing feedback and recommendations to improve system design and code quality.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to integrate applications into CI/CD pipelines and automate deployment processes.


Testing and Quality Assurance:


  • Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and automated tests to ensure software quality.
  • Identify and resolve defects and performance issues, conducting thorough code reviews to maintain high standards of code quality.
  • Work closely with QA teams to implement and improve testing strategies and processes.


Collaboration and Teamwork:


  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality features and enhancements.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing to the continuous improvement of the team’s processes.
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing updates on progress and potential challenges.


Mentorship and Leadership:


  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, sharing knowledge and best practices to help them grow in their roles.
  • Lead by example, demonstrating a strong work ethic, a commitment to quality, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Take ownership of features or projects, driving them from concept to completion with minimal supervision.


Continuous Improvement and Innovation:


  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, and bring new ideas to the team.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements, refactoring, or technical enhancements to optimize the software development lifecycle.
  • Participate in technical discussions and contribute to the evolution of the team’s technical direction.


Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Experience:


  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on full-stack development.
  • Proven experience working in agile environments, with the ability to adapt to changing requirements and priorities.


Technical Skills:


  • Proven experience in web development including working with Headless CMS systems, Digital Asset Management systems and front end development
  • Proficiency in modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js) and back-end technologies (e.g., Node.js, Python, .NET).
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and database design (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control (e.g., Git), and DevOps practices.


Soft Skills:


  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a detail-oriented approach and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to work well in a collaborative team environment.
  • A proactive attitude, with a willingness to take initiative and drive projects forward.
  • Attributes:
  • Passionate about technology and software development, with a continuous desire to learn and improve.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and capable of managing multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • High level of integrity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.


Life at Lennar

At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits.

Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn<https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/> for the latest job opportunities.

Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.
